name: Formula Racing - F1 Track Car Racing
summary:
Get behind the wheel and experience the excitement of Formula Racing! Take control of powerful formula racing cars, accelerate across challenging tracks and compete against rival drivers in thrilling races.

Push your driving skills to the limit as you navigate sharp turns, maintain control at high speeds and fight for the leading position. Every race is an opportunity to improve your performance, challenge your competitors and work toward victory.
